notes: Page 1 carries 'Revised: 11/2021' above the table header; pages 2-5 do not. Every page repeats the supplier legend, 'Miami Beach Fire Rescue / EMS Inventory', the print stamp '10/23/2026 7:29 PM' and a footer 'Page N of 5'.
The '10/23/2026 7:29 PM' stamp is a print/export time, not a revision date.
The check-mark column is blank on every row.
Prices, dates and supplier assignments are historical and unverified; they are recorded as printed.
Cell text is verbatim except that runs of whitespace are collapsed to a single space.
Cell fill colours are not captured; supplier identity is taken from the printed code text only. (Fills appear to follow the supplier, e.g. pink cells carry BT, but that is not asserted.)

bag_alias_text = trailing red/blue UPPERCASE cross-reference words in the ITEM cell; parenthetical notes such as '(PREFILLED)' and lower-case red annotations stay in item_text. item_cell_text keeps the whole ITEM cell verbatim.
No expiration, controlled or refrigerated annotations other than those flagged per row appear on the form.
